name: CertScore.ai MCP Light
tagline: No-auth public website privacy-risk scans with evidence and limitations
description: CertScore.ai MCP Light v0.2.26 is a hosted, no-auth Streamable HTTP server for bounded public website privacy-risk reviews. It exposes four tools: certscore_scan_site starts a scan or reuses an eligible recent result; certscore_get_scan_status follows scan progress; certscore_get_scan_bundle retrieves canonical findings and supporting evidence; and certscore_get_report_evidence_page retrieves focused or paginated report evidence. Reviews cover observed cookies and trackers, CMP and consent controls, privacy-policy and transparency signals, regulatory review context, and HTTPS/TLS observations. Results include evidence references and explicit coverage limitations for human or agentic review; they are not legal advice, certification, or a compliance determination.

install.notes: Connect directly to https://mcp.certscore.ai/mcp/light using Streamable HTTP. No account, API key, OAuth flow, Authorization header, or local executable is required. Hosted release: 0.2.26; official MCP Registry identity: ai.certscore/mcp-light. Keep scan creation under user control, honor returned polling guidance, retrieve the completed findings bundle, and use certscore_get_report_evidence_page for focused or paginated evidence. Scoped daily and rolling usage limits apply; see https://certscore.ai/developers/mcp#light-usage-limits.
